note: Quaderno: a code editor. A menu bar, an explorer tree, editor tabs with unsaved dots (closing an unsaved one asks first), a generated 5,000-line file, Goto Anything (Cmd+P; file@symbol, file:line), symbols in the project (Cmd+Shift+R), Find in Files (Cmd+Shift+F, F4 for the next result), every command in a palette (Cmd+Shift+P), the TODO and FIXME lines as problems (updated on save), and a terminal. A find panel (Cmd+F, Cmd+Alt+F to replace), word wrap (Alt+Cmd+W) and a ruler at column 80 (View); multiple selections, Cmd+/ comments, line operations.

computed.tree: {{[{ id: 'd:root', label: state.project, children: concat([{ id: 'd:src', label: 'src', children: map(filter(range(length(state.files)), state.files[it].folder == 'src'), { id: 'f' + it, label: state.files[it].name }) }, { id: 'd:screens', label: 'screens', children: map(filter(range(length(state.files)), state.files[it].folder == 'screens'), { id: 'f' + it, label: state.files[it].name }) }], map(filter(range(length(state.files)), state.files[it].folder == ''), { id: 'f' + it, label: state.files[it].name })) }]}}
computed.tabItems: {{map(state.tabs, { id: text(it), label: state.files[it].name, marker: state.files[it].dirty })}}
computed.picks: {{map(filter(range(length(state.files)), !state.files[it].scratch), { title: state.files[it].name, detail: state.project + '/' + (state.files[it].folder ? state.files[it].folder + '/' : '') + state.files[it].name, file: it })}}
computed.lineItems: {{computed.gotoFile < 0 ? [] : [number(computed.search) ? { title: 'Go to line ' + clamp(number(computed.search), 1, length(computed.gotoLines)), detail: state.files[computed.gotoFile].name, file: computed.gotoFile, line: clamp(number(computed.search), 1, length(computed.gotoLines)) } : { title: 'Type a line number, 1 to ' + length(computed.gotoLines), detail: state.files[computed.gotoFile].name, file: computed.gotoFile }]}}
computed.found: {{empty(computed.search) ? [] : slice(map(filter(range(length(computed.gotoLines)), contains(lower(computed.gotoLines[it]), computed.search)), { title: trim(computed.gotoLines[it]), detail: 'line ' + (it + 1), file: computed.gotoFile, line: it + 1, column: indexOf(lower(computed.gotoLines[it]), computed.search) + 1, length: length(computed.search) }), 0, 50)}}
computed.palette: {{map(filter(commands, it.enabled), { title: it.category + ': ' + it.title, detail: it.keyLabel || '', run: it.name })}}
computed.findQuery: {{state.findBar.open && !state.findBar.inFiles && !empty(state.findBar.text) ? {text: state.findBar.text, regex: state.findBar.regex, wholeWord: state.findBar.wholeWord, caseSensitive: state.findBar.caseSensitive, inSelection: state.findBar.inSelection, replace: state.findBar.replace, step: state.findBar.step, request: state.findBar.request} : state.active >= 0 && state.active == computed.resultsFile ? {text: state.results.query, caseSensitive: state.findBar.caseSensitive} : null}}

prepare.note: Generates the large file once (5,000 lines, a TODO every 1,000), then finds the problems

prepare.to: {{join(map(range(5000), index == 0 ? '// Calibration tables for the station sensors (generated, 5,000 lines)' : index % 25 == 0 ? '' : index % 25 == 1 ? 'double sensor' + floor(index / 25) + '(double raw) {' : index % 25 == 23 ? '    return raw;' : index % 25 == 24 ? '}' : index % 1000 == 507 ? '    // TODO: recalibrate sensor ' + floor(index / 25) + ' after the winter readings' : '    raw += ' + (index * 37) % 1000 + ' / 1000.0;'), '\n')}}

findProblems.note: Every line with TODO (a warning) or FIXME (an error) in the saved files, as rows of the problems table

do.to: {{concat(state.problems, map(filter(range(length(state.scan)), contains(state.scan[it], 'TODO') || contains(state.scan[it], 'FIXME')), { id: f + ':' + (it + 1), cells: [contains(state.scan[it], 'FIXME') ? 'Error' : 'Warning', state.files[f].name, it + 1, slice(state.scan[it], indexOf(state.scan[it], contains(state.scan[it], 'FIXME') ? 'FIXME' : 'TODO'))] }))}}

close.note: with: file; an unsaved file asks first

closeNow.note: with: file; the next tab takes its place

pickTreeRow.note: A file row opens the file, a folder row opens or closes the folder

openProblem.note: A problem row chosen: its id is 'file:line'

indexFile.note: with: file; its symbols for Goto Symbol (@) and Goto Symbol in Project: Markdown headings, C++ classes, structs and function definitions

indexFile.to: {{map(filter(map(split(state.files[file].text, '\n'), { t: it, line: index + 1 }), state.files[file].language == 'Markdown' ? slice(it.t, 0, 1) == '#' : (state.files[file].language == 'C++' && indexOf(' \t#/}', slice(it.t, 0, 1)) < 0 && (slice(it.t, 0, 6) == 'class ' || slice(it.t, 0, 7) == 'struct ' || (contains(it.t, '(') && !contains(it.t, ';'))))), { title: slice(it.t, 0, 1) == '#' ? trim(join(split(it.t, '#'), '')) : contains(' class struct ', ' ' + split(it.t, ' ')[0] + ' ') ? split(trim(split(it.t, '{')[0]), ' ')[1] : reverse(split(trim(split(it.t, '(')[0]), ' '))[0], badge: slice(it.t, 0, 1) == '#' ? '#' : contains(' class struct ', ' ' + split(it.t, ' ')[0] + ' ') ? 'c' : 'f', badgeColor: slice(it.t, 0, 1) == '#' ? '#4a3f5e' : contains(' class struct ', ' ' + split(it.t, ' ')[0] + ' ') ? '#5a4a2c' : '#3a4b66', detail: (state.files[file].folder ? state.files[file].folder + '/' : '') + state.files[file].name + ':' + it.line, file: file, line: it.line })}}

typeCommand.note: with: name; runs a terminal command as if typed

goToPlace.note: with: item, a row with a file (opened) and a line (and a column and a length: selects them)

searchFiles.note: Writes every matching line of the files that 'Where' names (<open folders>, <open files>, or parts of paths separated by commas) into the Find Results buffer, as Find in Files does

scopeFiles.note: Sets findBar.scope to the files that 'Where' names

do.if: {{!state.files[f].scratch && (state.findBar.where == '<open files>' ? contains(state.tabs, f) : state.findBar.where == '<open folders>' || empty(trim(state.findBar.where)) || some(split(state.findBar.where, ','), contains((state.files[f].folder ? state.files[f].folder + '/' : '') + state.files[f].name, trim(it))))}}

do.note: Lists the matches in Find Results, then replaces them (plain text, case sensitive) in the files 'Where' names

openResult.note: with: line, a line of the Find Results buffer; a match line ('   12: text') opens its file there, under the path line above it

children.note: An application type (examples/shared/CodeEditor.cpp, registered by the host): an "editor" whose "language" gives the commands; "grammar" colours it with the @syntax tokens

children.text: No file open. Pick one in the side bar, or press Cmd+P.
No problems: no TODO or FIXME left in the saved files.

children.placeholder: Where: <open folders>, <open files>, or folders and files separated by commas

children.text: {{computed.file ? 'Line ' + state.caret.line + ', Column ' + state.caret.column + (state.caret.selected ? '; ' + state.caret.selected + ' characters selected' : '') : ''}}

with.title: Do you want to save the changes you made to {{state.closing.file >= 0 ? state.files[state.closing.file].name : ''}}?
with.message: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
